title: Treated wood stress adjustments.
officialText:
The allowable unit stresses for preservative-treated wood need no
adjustment for treatment, but are subject to other adjustments. The allowable unit stresses for fire-retardant-treated
wood, including fastener values, shall be developed from an approved method of investigation that considers
the effects of anticipated temperature and humidity to which the fire-retardant-treated wood will be subjected,
the type of treatment and the redrying process. Other adjustments are applicable except that the impact load
duration shall not apply.
